title: Red Keycard

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Used to get free passage between Snowdrift Stations.

body: The Red Keycard or Observatory Keycard is a Item bought at the Observatory in the Snowlands. It is used to get passage between Snowdrift Station's without paying the $2,500 fee. It costs $50,000 from the Observatory on the second floor which requires a Lab Card to gain access to. The Key card can be equipped ("covering" the Scuba Tank but in its own slot still) similar to the Lab Card.
